name: Package updates
description: Pending repo and AUR update count from `haseen update check` (checkupdates on a private database, the AUR helper's -Qua), hidden while nothing is pending. A left click runs `haseen update`, a right click lists the packages. Adopted from the owner's t1nk33r.updates; off by default

alwaysShow.description: Keep the icon in the bar while the system is up to date

splitAur.description: Show repo+AUR (12+3) instead of one total while AUR updates wait

listLines.description: Package lines the panel lists before summing up the rest
